info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Galena Recliner Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Galena Recliner Detail Creation API facilitates the submission of detailed information for the Galena Recliner product. This API enables businesses to enhance their product catalogs by adding or updating specifications, features, and descriptions that apply to the Galena Recliner. Typical consumers of this API include e-commerce platforms and inventory management systems looking to maintain comprehensive and accurate product listings. By leveraging this API, developers can ensure that their catalog data remains current and appealing to potential customers.

post.description: This operation allows you to either create new details for the Galena recliner or update existing ones. It is designed for developers to easily manage the information associated with this specific product in a streamlined manner.
